meta.description: Watches an accounts-payable mailbox, pushes every PDF/image attachment into LedgerLens, waits for the pipeline to settle, and posts a Slack alert only when a document needs a human. Import into a self-hosted n8n (free, local Docker).

nodes.name: AP Mailbox (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Any IMAP mailbox. Swap for the Gmail node if you prefer OAuth.

nodes.name: POST /v1/documents
nodes.notes: SHA-256 of the bytes is the idempotency key: the same attachment forwarded twice returns the existing record instead of double-processing.

nodes.name: Needs a human?
nodes.notes: Clean documents commit silently. Only exceptions interrupt anyone — an alert that fires on everything gets muted within a week.
